name: Campus Fire Exit Core (Phone Walkthrough)
description: Core 4-rule phone walkthrough audit for campus corridors and labs. Verifies visible extinguishers, illuminated exit signage, unobstructed exit paths, and clear extinguisher access without requiring optical scale measurements.
disclaimer: AuditLens is an assistive pre-audit tool. It does not certify legal compliance. Verify against institutional safety standards and local fire codes.

rules.title: Fire extinguisher is mounted and clearly visible
rules.evidence_needed: Visual segmentation mask, confidence >= 0.60, timestamp citation
rules.fix_text: Mount a certified fire extinguisher on the wall in a prominent, unobstructed location.

rules.title: Emergency exit sign is clearly visible above doorways
rules.evidence_needed: Illuminated green/red exit signage detected above egress doorways
rules.fix_text: Ensure all emergency exit signage is clearly visible and unobstructed.

rules.title: Exit corridor and doorway are free of blocking obstacles
rules.evidence_needed: Absence of boxes, carts, furniture, or debris directly obstructing egress
rules.fix_text: Immediately relocate all obstacles, boxes, and furniture blocking the exit doorway or path.

rules.title: Area in front of fire extinguisher is clear and accessible
rules.evidence_needed: Absence of obstructing storage or items directly in front of the extinguisher
rules.fix_text: Maintain a clear access radius of at least 1 meter around the fire extinguisher.
